title: Cross-Calibrated Confidence Fields for Local Risk Updates
abstract: arXiv:2606.19147v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How can training data be used to compare local updates to the current model, choose an update, and retain valid bounds for the selected update's population-risk change? We construct lower and upper confidence fields that jointly cover the population-risk change of every update in a possibly continuous local update space. The fields can therefore be used both to compare the updates and to select an update; a negative upper endpoint certifies improvement over the reference model. For linear risk changes in possibly infinite-dimensional feature spaces, cross-calibration uses the discrepancy between two balanced folds to calibrate the full-sample estimation error. Under covariance-aligned sub-Gaussian tails, covariance-estimation stability, and sufficient sample size, the cross-calibrated field has finite-sample simultaneous coverage. The confidence field's directional widths are governed by a population ridge effective dimension r

translated_title: 交叉校准置信场用于局部更新风险
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.19147v3 公告类型：replace-cross  摘要：如何利用训练数据来比较当前模型的局部更新、选择更新，并为所选更新的总体风险变化保留有效界限？我们构建了下置信场和上置信场，它们共同覆盖了可能连续的局部更新空间中每个更新的总体风险变化。因此，这些场既可以用于比较更新，也可以用于选择更新；负的上端点证明相对于参考模型有所改进。对于可能在无限维特征空间中的线性风险变化，交叉校准利用两个平衡折叠之间的差异来校准全样本估计误差。在协方差对齐的子高斯尾部、协方差估计稳定性以及足够样本量条件下，交叉校准场具有有限样本的联合覆盖性。置信场的定向宽度由总体岭有效维度r控制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种交叉校准置信场方法，能够同时覆盖局部更新空间中所有更新的总体风险变化，从而支持更新比较与选择，并在有限样本下保证联合覆盖性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces cross-calibrated confidence fields that jointly cover population-risk changes for all updates in a local update space, enabling comparison and selection while ensuring finite-sample simultaneous coverage.
